reasoning: Base ratings: the Rockets are +7.2 and the Nuggets +3.4 points per game against an average team; with home court that makes the Rockets 4.4 better here, total 226.
Rest, travel and availability barely move it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: Rockets by 4.5, 70% to win; total 226 (80% range 202-250).
